card.name: Accidental ingestion warning, especially by children
card.fires_on: The word "children" in opioid label warnings about accidental ingestion, right after "especially by". It also fires on "in" in "can result in" within the same warnings.

modes.label: Children after 'especially by'

card.writes: It seems to push toward words of obligation or prohibition such as "must" and "strictly forbidden", and away from words of reassurance.
